card.name: Linking words inside foreign-language titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" and "and" right after a foreign-language or Latinised title, place name or list item in encyclopedia-style text. It also fires on a few other words in these settings, such as "translation".

modes.label: "of" after a title
modes.description: The word "of" follows a foreign-language book title or its translation, often before a date.

modes.description: The word "and" follows a foreign place name or publisher in a list or citation.
